# Brandt Industrial

- **What it is:** a privately held industrial manufacturer founded in 1962 by the Brandt family.
  Designs and builds **centrifugal & positive-displacement pumps, industrial valves, and
  hydraulic power units (HPUs)**.
- **Markets served:** agriculture (irrigation, equipment OEMs), construction machinery, and
  municipal water/wastewater.
- **Size:** ~1,400 employees across **four plants** (see [operations](operations.md)); ~$540M
  annual revenue; order backlog ~$88M.
- **Ownership:** majority owned by the Brandt family; a minority stake held by a private-equity
  firm (Ridgeline Capital) since 2019. Board chair is [Howard Brandt](../people/howard-brandt.md),
  grandson of the founder.
- **Financial shape (2026):** EBITDA margin compressed to ~9% (target 13%) on input-cost
  inflation and productivity misses; carries a **$120M revolving credit facility** with
  [First Meridian Bank](../people/ellen-marsh.md) that has a net-leverage covenant (see
  [Refinancing](../projects/refinancing.md)).
- **Labor:** the Rockford and Toledo plants are unionized (USW); Greenville and Monterrey are
  not. Union relationship runs through steward [Dave Kowalski](../people/dave-kowalski.md).

## Strategic posture
- Mid-tech, operations-heavy business; competes on delivery reliability, engineering, and price.
- Turnaround footing: margin recovery, productivity, and a hard look at the plant footprint are
  the CEO's mandate from the board.
